newsitem.title: USA: Physician Corp completes sale of HMOs.
newsitem.headline: Physician Corp completes sale of HMOs.

text.p: Physician Corp of America said Wednesday it had completed the sale of its Georgia and Alabama HMOs to Health Partners of Alabama Inc for $24.5 million.
The sale eliminates more than $1 million in monthly operating losses, which puts the company "back into the black," Physician Corp said.
The company said it expects a third quarter after-tax gain of about $4.5 million from the sale, which will be used to reduce its bank debt to $118.5 million.
Physician Corp said it would concentrate in its core markets in Texas, Florida and Puerto Rico.
